text:
Alex Chen: Quick kickoff — Orion Retail onboarding starts Mon 2026-04-06. Need final stakeholder roster, explicit success criteria for first 14 days, and owners for each milestone. Can we confirm timeline and any renewal risk signals up front? @Marco Ruiz @Dana Lee @Priya Patel

Priya Patel: I can own enablement (docs + lunch-and-learn). Will post a 60-min agenda by EOD. Do we want a product deep-dive or integration workshop first? :thinking:

Marco Ruiz: Stakeholders I have so far: Lina Torres (Head of Product), Omar Haddad (Infra/Netops), Jess Carter (Data). Lina prefers Tue mornings. FYI renewal note — CSM mentioned a budget review in ~45 days, marked as medium risk.

Dana Lee: I'll handle technical onboarding tasks: env setup, API keys, sample dataset ingestion, smoke tests. Will send a pre-checklist tomorrow. For Private (on-prem) option, need network contact + firewall rule owner.

Alex Chen: Proposal for success criteria (14-day): 1) Staging end-to-end test traffic with median gen latency <200ms; 2) 10 representative prompts pass quality gates (no hallucination rate >5%); 3) Console access provisioned for 3 engineers; 4) Billing/quota validated and first invoice estimate delivered. Thoughts?

Marco Ruiz: Agree on 1-4. Add: pin model to rw-v1.3 for initial rollouts to avoid unexpected model updates. Also include a data handling signoff for any PII concerns.

Priya Patel: +1. I'll schedule the enablement session for Wed 10:00am PT (invites after I post agenda). I'll run through console, common error patterns, and quick troubleshooting flows.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Orion - Enablement" Wed 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC — https://calendar.example/evt/12345 :calendar:

Dana Lee: Pre-checklist draft (will share as doc): - Provide IP allowlist entries - Create service account + API key - Share sample payload schema and mapping - Upload test prompt set to shared drive

Example quick test (for engineers):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1.3","prompt":"<test>","max_tokens":128}'
```

Alex Chen: Thanks. Can someone volunteer to own the 14-day health check doc (metrics + blockers + renewal signal)? It'll be a short sync + one-pager.

Marco Ruiz: I'll take the 14-day health check. I'll draft a one-pager with owners, KPIs (latency, error rate, quality pass rate), and next-steps by day 12.

Priya Patel: I'll capture enablement feedback via a short Google Form and share results into the playbook.

Alex Chen: Great — I'll update the onboarding playbook and tag the owners above. Next sync cadence: enablement (Wed), quick go/no-go check Fri. :thumbsup:

Marco Ruiz: Heads up — Omar asked for an SLA exceptions doc for initial limits; I'll loop him into the doc and ping infra upstream.

Dana Lee: Done — created shared drive folder and uploaded the checklist draft: https://drive.example/folder/Onboarding-Orion

Alex Chen: Final note — mark the budget review in 45 days as a renewal risk and add to the Renewal Signals tab in the customer GSheet. I'll include mitigation steps (exec sponsor intro, weekly usage highlights).
